source.title: Duskwood Mission XVII: Rescue Alara Grovemender
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Darmstead. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Alara Grovemender there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
source.objective: Rescue Alara Grovemender in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the stable at the Yorgen Farmstead and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
